chain.title: Follow The Pollen
chain.desc: A lily of the valley bound with an amethyst shard. Hold it and its pollen drifts toward the nearest Void Blossom lair - it is the mod's compass, not a weapon, and it is reusable.

chain.title: The Lair Underground
chain.desc: A bramble-walled cavern deep below the surface, holding the boss spawner. Clear a fighting space before you wake anything up.

chain.title: Extreme Weeding
chain.desc: 350 health, spike waves from the floor and petal blades on the air. The first of the four bosses and the gate to every craftable item in the mod.

chain.title: Torn From The Bloom
chain.desc: Two drop per kill, and only if you land the killing blow yourself. That is exactly enough for the two recipes that want one - the Earthdive Spear and the Charged Ender Pearl - so a single Blossom covers you unless you want spares.

chain.title: Sweet Thing From A Killer
chain.desc: Two or three per kill. Eat one for a short burst of regeneration and resistance - keep a few for the fights further down this list.

chain.title: Fifty Undead Later
chain.desc: Kill fifty undead - zombies, skeletons, husks, drowned, phantoms and their kin - and a Soul Star drops. Hold it and it points you at the Night Lich's tower.

chain.title: The Tower In The Cold
chain.desc: A tall spire in cold biomes with chests worth looting on the way up. The Lich waits at the top; the Soul Star gets you there.

chain.title: Night Vanquisher
chain.desc: 300 health, heals itself whenever you break off, and rains comets and homing missiles. Bring a bow and something to break line of sight.

chain.title: What The Lich Was Made Of
chain.desc: Two per kill. It is the magic half of the mod's crafting: the Staff of Suppression, the Table of Elevation and the Charged Ender Pearl all need it.

chain.title: The Blackstone Arena
chain.desc: A sealed blackstone hall in the Nether. Nothing points you to it, so ride the roof or use a locator - it is the one boss with no finding item.

chain.title: Through The Gauntlet
chain.desc: A floating stone hand: 250 health, heavy armour, spin punches that blast holes in the arena, and a charged laser. It leaves ancient debris where it dies.

chain.title: Prize Of The Blackstone Arena
chain.desc: Comes out of the chest the Gauntlet leaves behind. Needed for the Blast Amplifier and the Table of Elevation, so two kills is the realistic target.

chain.title: The Altar In The End
chain.desc: Out past the main island, on the End's outer stone. The mod's own advancement hangs this one off killing the dragon, so treat it as post-dragon content.

chain.title: Obsidian Obliterator
chain.desc: 300 health, 14 armour and telegraphed pillar, wave, spike and anvil attacks. Read the ground markers - every attack shows you where it lands first.

chain.title: The Pillar's Core
chain.desc: From the Obsidilith's loot chest, along with End City treasure and a stack each of purpur and obsidian. Three separate recipes want one - the Earthdive Spear, the Staff of Suppression and the Blast Amplifier - and only one drops per fight.

chain.title: Through Solid Stone
chain.desc: Throw it and you teleport to where it lands, straight through walls and floors. The fastest way into a cave system you have not dug into yet.

chain.title: The Pearl That Comes Back
chain.desc: A reusable ender pearl that leaves you with brief resistance after the teleport, so the landing damage stops mattering. You only ever need one.

chain.title: Nothing Dares Approach
chain.desc: The Staff of Suppression. Placed, it stops mob spawning for 64 blocks in every direction - one of them will light-proof an entire base.

chain.title: Louder Detonations
chain.desc: The Blast Amplifier raises explosion power by 30% within 64 blocks. It does not stack, so one placed near your quarry is the whole benefit.

chain.title: A Column Of Flight
chain.desc: The Table of Elevation gives creative-style flight inside a 7x7 column above it. Build it at the bottom of a shaft and the climb disappears.

chain.title: Wind The Arenas Back
chain.desc: Netherite scrap, dragon breath and a ghast tear. Using it resets nearby boss structures so a cleared arena spawns its boss again - this is how you farm the drops above.

collections.note: Arena building blocks. They generate in the boss structures and are decoration, not progression.

notes:
VERIFIED against BOMD-Forge-1.20.1-1.1.1.jar (an earlier pass of this file checked 1.1.2; the item set and data are identical between them). The registered item set is the 21 real stems of assets/bosses_of_mass_destruction/models/item/*.json - the 24 files there include three model helpers (spear, throwing, earthdive_spear_throwing) that are not items. Every id above is in that set, and in assets/bosses_of_mass_destruction/lang/en_us.json.

ALL FOUR BOSSES verified as entity.bosses_of_mass_destruction.* lang keys: lich (Night Lich), obsidilith (Obsidilith), gauntlet (Nether Gauntlet), void_blossom (Void Blossom). Non-boss entities that must NOT be used as kill targets: comet, blue_fireball, soul_star, spore_ball, petal_blade - those are projectiles.

ORDER SOURCE: the author's four boss advancements in data/bosses_of_mass_destruction/advancements/, whose parents encode the intended tier. void_blossom_defeat and night_lich_defeat both hang off minecraft:adventure/kill_a_mob (early, overworld); gauntlet_defeat hangs off minecraft:nether/root; obsidilith_defeat hangs off minecraft:end/kill_dragon, which is the explicit statement that the Obsidilith is post-dragon. Crafting order after that is forced by data/bosses_of_mass_destruction/recipes/: earthdive_spear = void_thorn + obsidian_heart; charged_ender_pearl = void_thorn + ancient_anima + ender pearl; mob_ward = ancient_anima + obsidian_heart + obsidian; blast_amplifier (result monolith_block) = blazing_eye + obsidian_heart + obsidian; levitation_block = ancient_anima + blazing_eye + gold + obsidian. Every device needs two different bosses' drops, which is why all four kills sit above all five crafts.

SOUL STAR IS A KILL COUNTER, NOT LOOT OR A CRAFT. It has no recipe and no loot table. The mechanic lives in the config: lichConfig.summonMechanic.numEntitiesKilledToDropSoulStar = 50, with entitiesThatCountToSummonCounter listing skeleton, giant, phantom, zoglin, zombified_piglin, wither_skeleton, husk, skeleton_horse, stray, zombie_horse, zombie, drowned, wither and zombie_villager. Telling the player 'kill fifty undead' is the single most useful line in this chain - without it the Lich is unfindable.

FINDING ITEMS point at structures through structure tags: data/bosses_of_mass_destruction/tags/worldgen/structure/soul_star_target.json contains only lich_tower, and void_lily_target.json contains only void_blossom. Their lang tooltips are literally 'Where does it lead?' and 'Where does the pollen lead?'. There is NO finding item for the Gauntlet or the Obsidilith - the chain says so rather than inventing one.

BOSS DROPS split between entity tables and reward chests. data/.../loot_tables/entities/void_blossom.json drops 2 void_thorn plus 2-3 crystal_fruit, and entities/lich.json drops 2 ancient_anima plus bones and diamonds - both gated on minecraft:killed_by_player, so the player must land the kill. blazing_eye and obsidian_heart are NOT entity drops: they come from loot_tables/chests/gauntlet.json and loot_tables/chests/obsidilith.json, the chests the bosses leave behind. The obsidilith chest also rolls minecraft:chests/end_city_treasure plus 64 purpur and 64 obsidian.

STRUCTURES verified in data/bosses_of_mass_destruction/worldgen/structure/: gauntlet_arena, lich_tower, obsidilith_arena, void_blossom. Biome placement from tags/worldgen/biome/collections/: lich_tower in 'cold', gauntlet_arena in 'in_nether', obsidilith_arena in 'in_end'. There is no custom dimension in this mod, so no dim: steps exist.

STAT NUMBERS in the descs come from the mod's own config json5: lich 300 hp, obsidilith 300 hp / 14 armour / spawnPillarOnDeath, gauntlet 250 hp / 8 armour / spawnAncientDebrisOnDeath, void_blossom 350 hp. Device effects are quoted from the item tooltips in en_us.json (64-block radii for mob_ward and monolith_block, 7x7 column for levitation_block, 'Resets nearby boss structures on use' for brimstone_nectar); generalConfig.tableOfElevationRadius = 3 gives the 7x7.

BRIMSTONE NECTAR is the one item craftable without a boss kill (netherite scrap + dragon breath + ghast tear), but it is listed last because its whole purpose is re-fighting bosses you have already beaten.
